jobs.description: Role: Staff Engineer (Integrations / Supply, air travel) Company: Voyagu Location: Fully remote, Europe preferred. European time zone; about two hours of difference is fine. About eight hours online, and some overlap with US time zones helps because many users are there. Job Type: Full-time. Contract model is flexible: contractor, payroll provider or direct employment. About Voyagu Voyagu builds one platform that runs several travel businesses. Today the focus is air travel. The platform covers client management (CRM), ERP modules for finance and accounting, travel operations, and integrations with travel supply systems. The model is offline travel: agencies that sell through people. Voyagu does not sell the software and does not plan to, but agencies work with it in different models. It is a bootstrap scaleup, so teams are lean and money is counted. Development leans heavily on AI. Teams of AI agents run big features under a business operator and a technical operator. Sometimes this turns two half-years of work into two weeks. It does not always work. When code is cheap, product vision and architecture become the bottleneck, and that is where you come in. This role owns the integrations and supply direction. Air travel alone is deep: every airline has its own distribution channels and APIs. You would lead one of five platform development streams and report to the CTO. There is no product manager in between, and you work directly with the founder and other business stakeholders. The team has no one with your profile today, so you would be the first. What you are expected to do Technical ownership Lead the integrations and supply direction as its technical owner. Build integrations with GDS systems. Voyagu works with one today and needs more. Connect airline direct APIs and non-GDS protocols across multiple sources. Handle servicing after sale: changes, cancellations, refunds, and group bookings split into parts. Work with live, real-time availability. Seat availability does not depend on price. Prevent costly errors. One missed booking can mean tens of thousands of dollars. Design for reliability, for example with idempotency, so nothing is paid or bought twice. Keep the solution sized to Voyagu’s scale and avoid over-design. This is not internet-scale work. Keep the system stable. Speed and error rate are the measures. Vision and delivery Shape the technical vision with stakeholders and defend it. They will challenge it. Expect no ready-made tasks. Business stakeholders give you a direction, not a finished task. Turn the agreed platform capabilities into features and give estimates. Several dozen capabilities are written down, such as search and booking. Success means Voyagu accepts your estimates and you deliver them, or come close. Part of the plan will be agreed together with you. Our Future Projects unit is dedicated to expanding and complementing these capabilities by conceptualizing and pre-developing new technologies, products and programs. Contribute to the coordination of technical tasks of the different specialist engineers within a project, ensuring links between schedule and tasks. Contribute to the co-engineering sessions between the engineering team and potential external partners (setup the agenda, coordinate priorities, take decisions, take the MoM, track the actions). jobs.description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4><span data-teams="true">About the Role</span></h4> <p>You will develop software for system and regression testing of our robots, including test scripts, test tools, and automation solutions. Your core output will be high-quality, reusable test software that helps the team improve the efficiency, coverage, and repeatability of robot system testing.</p> <p>This is a development engineer role. You will collaborate with the robotics test and system test engineers in the team to develop scripts, tools, and automation solutions for key software and hardware test scenarios across our robot systems.</p> <p>In addition to software development, you will have the opportunity to participate directly in validation and debugging work on physical robots and in simulation environments. You will run and refine the tools and automated test solutions you develop on real systems, gaining first-hand insight into how robots behave and the challenges they face in real-world environments.</p> <h4>Your Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Develop system, integration, and regression test scripts in Python or C++ for various robotic platforms</li> <li>Develop ROS 2-based test tools, such as nodes for stimulating and monitoring the system, tools for data recording and replay, log and rosbag analysis, and test result reporting</li> <li>Debug, validate, run, and maintain automated test solutions in simulation environments and on physical robots</li> <li>Develop scripts and tools for long-duration stability, performance, and fault-injection testing</li> <li>Work with system test engineers in the team to turn manual test scenarios suitable for automation into stable, reusable test scripts</li> <li>Integrate test scripts into CI/CD pipelines so that they run automatically with each build</li> <li>Maintain test code quality through code reviews, documentation, and version control</li> <li>Use the tools you develop to support issue reproduction, diagnosis, and analysis</li> </ul> <h4>What You Bring</h4> <ul> <li>Hands-on ROS 2 development experience gained through work, internships, a thesis, or student projects; able to write nodes using rclpy or rclcpp, with familiarity in topics, services, actions, parameters, launch files, and rosbag</li> <li>A robotics background, with practical experience in robot development or testing through work, internships, a working student role, a thesis, or student projects</li> <li>Strong programming skills in at least one of Python or C++</li> <li>A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field; jobs.title: Director B2B2C Growth Partnerships
jobs.description: Meet Urban Sports Club We are among the leading platforms for sports and wellness in Europe, dedicated to inspiring people to live active, healthy lives. With just one membership we offer access to thousands of fitness and wellness experiences across the continent. But what truly sets us apart? We believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. If you're curious about how we work, what we value and how you might grow with us, explore our Culture Hub & Career Opportunities . *Big news: Wellhub and Urban Sports Club unite!* Urban Sports Club is now a proud part of Wellhub, creating a global wellbeing ecosystem. Together, we connect 39,000 corporate clients and 97,000 wellness partners across 18 countries, offering millions of people even more ways to stay active and take care of their health.   The opportunity    Urban Sports Club is looking for an experienced and commercially driven Director, B2B2C Growth Partnerships to establish and scale one of our most strategic growth channels across Europe. In this role, you will define the commercial strategy and operating model for our B2B2C business, enabling Urban Sports Club's membership offering to be seamlessly integrated into partner ecosystems including banks, insurers, retailers, telcos, travel companies, loyalty programmes, marketplaces, and digital platforms. This role plays a key part in building stronger fraud observability and smarter decisioning for fast growing card issuing and banking volumes across the globe. jobs.title: Technicien / Ingénieur Intégration & Validation Cryogénique
jobs.description: Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie. Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels. Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques. Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes. En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀 À propos du poste Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) / Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy. Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats , nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration. Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation. Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques. Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés. Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international. Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série , avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production. Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes. À ce titre, vous : Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration. jobs.title: RWE Biostatistician
jobs.description: 🏨 The company Resilience Care is a leading French remote patient monitoring (RPM) company and a clinical research partner, founded in 2021 with a mission: better care. We provide RPM solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, combining ePRO collection with AI techniques. Our platform supports healthcare professionals with early side‑effect detection for continuous and proactive care, and our patient mobile app helps measure and manage symptoms with tailored resources. Our solutions improve care pathways, enrich continuous patient understanding, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and in‑depth analysis of real‑world data. They are currently deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across 200+ healthcare institutions, and also support around twenty academic and industry clinical studies. We put data at the service of care and therapeutic innovation, with the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine. 📝 Your role In a nutshell : you will help build and deliver robust statistical work for Real‑World Evidence (RWE) and Medical Affairs studies — from analysis planning (SAP) to reproducible programming and clear interpretation. Your impact : make study execution more reliable, faster and more reproducible (plans, code and reporting), enabling cross‑functional teams to make informed decisions. Your day‑to‑day Draft and/or contribute to Statistical Analysis Plans (SAP) and methodological documentation. Program analyses in R and Python; concept of SQL/Postgre. Contribute to RWE studies : design, methods and execution. Set up data quality checks (consistency, cohort rules) and document assumptions. Produce decision‑ready deliverables (tables/figures/reporting) and explain results to non‑statisticians (internal or external actors). ✨ Your team Your future teammates : Dynamic team with medical and pharma expertise Your manager : Nicoleta - Director Translational Research – RWE & Biostatistics 👤 Profile ⚙️ You are a good fit if you can : Apply biostatistics (survival analysis: Kaplan‑Meier, log‑rank, Cox; regression; GLM/GLMM; matching/weighting). Write clean, reproducible code ( R, Python; basic SQL). Work with patient healthcare data (quality, traceability, constraints). Produce clear statistical/methodological documentation (protocole, SAPs, reports). Build meaningful data visualisations. Communicate insights to diverse audiences. 🙂 You are a good fit if you have : High methodological rigor and attention to detail. Autonomy and ownership mindset. Ability to prioritize and handle multiple studies in parallel. Clear communication and collaborative approach. Resilience when facing methodological push‑back. 📃 You are a good fit if you have already : 2–4 years of experience in biostatistics/RWE (CRO, consultancy or similar environments). Delivered analyses on healthcare datasets. Built reusable outputs (codebases, pipelines, reporting templates). Worked closely with non‑technical stakeholders. A plus if you: Know good practices/guidelines (GxP, ICH E9/E9(R1)). Have exposure to machine learning applied to healthcare data. Have worked with external vendors (Pharma, CRO’s etc). 💛 Why join us? High‑impact healthcare mission at the intersection of care, data and clinical research. Broad scope: RWE, Medical Affairs studies, standardisation and automation. Hiring process Screening (15 min) : motivation, prerequisites and context. Manager interview (45 min) : role expectations, methods and collaboration. Case study (45 min to 1 h) : technical discussions and practical use cases with multiple interviewers. Team fit - Panel interviews (30 min each) : discussions with multiple interviewers of the team. jobs.description: At Kandou , we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption. Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient . jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Product Catalogs
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://redditinc.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div><p><strong>This role is open to candidates based in the UK or the Netherlands.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Our ads team is developing Dynamic Product Ads, enabling us to match users to specific advertiser products. Our vision is for Reddit’s product ads to be highly relevant and contextual. A user browsing r/golf sees ads for popular golf clubs. A user reading a thread on r/buyitforlife about sunglasses sees ads for the exact models being discussed, just a few clicks away from a purchase. To achieve this vision, we need a highly scalable catalog infrastructure and intuitive user experience to onboard thousands of advertisers and ingest millions of products into our systems.</p> <p>As the Engineering Manager for the Product Catalogs team at Reddit, you will lead the full stack team responsible for our entire advertiser-facing experience. You will build UIs, APIs, and backend systems that manage advertiser’s products. The team also works closely with the knowledge graph teams to power organic shopping. This role combines technical expertise, leadership abilities, and drive to understand and deliver on customer needs.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Create a world class catalogs system that can scale to support billions of products</li> <li>Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences</li> <li>Collaborate with a wide range of teams from Ad Formats to Ad Delivery to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of product ads</li> <li>Establish and manage to SLAs within your team</li> <li>Be a strong mentor and cross-functional advocate for your team</li> <li>Contribute meaningfully to team strategy. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Zilveren Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 15% bedrijven van Nederland. Onze doelstelling is streven naar Goud in de komende jaren en volledig CO2 neutraal zijn in 2050. Applications such as the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. jobs.description: Your Mission: VÆRIDION is a pioneering electric aircraft Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) dedicated to revolutionizing regional air mobility and sustainable aviation. We are committed to designing and producing cutting-edge electric conventional take-off and landing (eCTOL) aircraft that provide safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly transportation solutions. As a Senior High Voltage Systems Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, development, and certification of the aircraft's high voltage systems. You will work as part of a multi-functional team, reporting to the HV Systems Team Lead, and covering HV system development and electrical integration, including battery systems, power electronics, HV EWIS, distribution equipment and associated sub-systems. Your daily tasks will include a variety of technical activities for the HV Electrical Systems team. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team. Your Day-to-Day: Define performance, functional, installation and other applicable system requirements, allocate them to components, and plan and support their validation and verification (V&V) in line with standards such as ARP4754. Define HV system functions, architecture, sizing and specifications, and integrate the aircraft HV distribution system to meet safety and performance requirements. Develop interface control documents (ICDs) covering physical and functional interfaces with the aircraft structure and related systems. Lead technical tasks for Microliner development and certification, and create system documentation from requirements definition to demonstration of compliance. Define aircraft-level HV electrical bonding and grounding requirements and their implementation. Coordinate HV system safety analyses and systems engineering activities, address environmental conditions including HIRF and EMI, and define lightning protection requirements for the HV propulsion electrical network based on the defined aircraft lightning zones. Define and specify the aircraft charging interface, and break down its requirements to component level. Specify power quality and electrical insulation requirements and draft the aircraft electrical load analysis, including tasks such as defining and maintaining a Y-capacitance budget for the propulsion electrical network and allocating limits to components. Support integration of the HV system digital mock-up (DMU) into the aircraft 3D model. Identify, assess and manage suppliers, and own work packages for the development, installation and integration of HV components, including fuses, switches, harnesses and grounding systems. Perform or support analyses and simulations to improve HV propulsion battery performance, reliability and integration into the propulsion system. Participate in supplier technical and program reviews (TRM and PRM) and key milestones, including PDR, CDR, First Flight and Type Certification. Define and plan HV equipment qualification campaigns with the Technology Department, suppliers and other stakeholders. Prepare, commission, troubleshoot and execute HV hardware and software tests, from component benches to full-scale prototypes and aircraft ground and flight tests. Follow engineering processes and standards, and contribute to design reviews supporting development and certification goals. Your Profile: Master’s degree or higher in electrical engineering or a related field. Proven experience of at least 5 years in electrical systems design and integration within an aerospace OEM or similar industry (preferably automotive). Experience with electric aircraft is a plus, including power electronics, energy storage and electric propulsion systems. Working knowledge of systems engineering and safety analyses per aerospace standards such as ARP4754 and ARP4761 or automotive standard such as ISO26262. Proficiency on airborne hardware and software qualification

jobs.title: People & Culture - Working Student (all genders)
jobs.description: About us At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful. Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de , we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens. Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way. As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments. Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before. Your Role Do you want to drive turn everyday People administration into a seamless, high-quality experience for every single employee? Are you ready to support both the operational engine and the talent growth of a fast-paced tech scale-up? If you are a detail-oriented student who loves supporting people and keeping processes sharp by bringing employees and business needs together, then you are our perfect match! Expect a steep learning curve, with experienced colleagues by your side. You will gain deep in-depth knowledge of the entire employee life cycle, from initial recruitment to the final stage of a successful career. What You’ll Do Support People Admin: You help our People Operations with everyday employee inquiries, such as holidays, workations and learning budgets, and you keep our Jira Service Management tickets moving with speed and care. Help Keep Data Accurate: You support the maintenance of employee master data and digital personal files, following clear guidelines, so that everything stays accurate and up to date. Document Support: You prepare employment certificates, reference letters and other essential HR documents in German and English. Talent Spotlight: You help us look after the perfect candidate, from the first review of applications for junior roles to taking notes in interviews, so that the experience stays world-class. Process Coordination: You help the recruiting process run smoothly by scheduling interviews and following up with stakeholders to keep the momentum high. What You’ll Bring Experience You are currently enrolled and studying Business Administration, Human Resources Management, Psychology, or a related subject. Initial experience in fast-paced companies or HR environment is a plus. Experience in a Tech Scale-up environment is a bonus. Skills Bilingual Proficiency: You speak and write German and English at a professional level (C1/Native). Organizational Talent: You can juggle multiple tasks and projects without losing your cool or your attention to detail. Tech Savvy: You are comfortable (or eager to learn) working with tools like Personio, Leapsome, Jira, and Google Workspace. Mindset Detail Lover: Accuracy is your quiet superpower. Discreet & Trustworthy: You handle sensitive data with care. Eager Learner: You see feedback as fuel. You enjoy both working as part of the People Team and collaborating with it: You come to our Berlin-Mitte office at least twice a week to work alongside us. Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto Best of Both Worlds: We live and breathe a flexible hybrid model. Our beautiful office at Hausvogteiplatz is our vibrant Berlin hub for collaboration, but you have the freedom to leverage the setup that works best for you. Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. Once you have completed your probation, you have the option to work remotely from within

jobs.title: Digitale Lohnbuchhaltung (w/m/d)
jobs.description: SKALAR – Wir bauen die Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert. Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich. Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen. Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung. Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen. Aufgaben Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung: Du verantwortest die monatliche Entgeltabrechnung deiner Mandanten in DATEV Lohn und Gehalt – unterstützt durch KI- und Automatisierungstools, die Routine minimieren und Tiefe ermöglichen. Meldewesen & Compliance: SV-Meldungen, Lohnsteueranmeldungen, Beitragsnachweise, Bescheinigungswesen sowie die Kommunikation mit Finanzämtern, Krankenkassen und Behörden – termingerecht und prüfungssicher. Mandantenbetreuung: Du richtest neue Mandanten ein, begleitest sie langfristig und bist erste/r Ansprechpartner/in für lohnsteuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtliche Fragen. Sonderfälle & Beratung: Bearbeitung komplexer Sachverhalte – von betrieblicher Altersvorsorge über Sachbezüge und Pfändungen bis zu Kurzarbeit und neuen regulatorischen Anforderungen (z. B. Mindestlohn, korrekte Lohnsteuerberechnung). Entwicklung neuer Beratungsleistungen: Du bestimmst mit, welche KI-gestützten Leistungen wir rund um Lohn und Personal entwickeln. Dein Lohn-Wissen + die Unterstützung durch unsere Softwareentwickler = Services, die klassische Kanzleien nicht anbieten können. Prozess- & Qualitätssicherung: Du gestaltest unsere Lohnprozesse aktiv mit – von der Mandanten-Schnittstelle über die Datenübernahme bis zur Lohnauswertung – und sorgst für gleichbleibend hohe Qualität. Qualifikationen Fachliche Basis: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte/r, Lohnbuchhalter/in, Fachassistent/in Lohn und Gehalt oder vergleichbare Qualifikation. Lohn-Praxis: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Entgeltabrechnung, sicher in Lohnsteuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht. Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV LODAS oder Lohn und Gehalt. Mandantenkompetenz: Empathische und klare Kommunikation mit Mandanten und deren Mitarbeitenden – auch bei komplexeren Themen. Sorgfalt & Termintreue: Der Lohn muss stimmen. Du arbeitest präzise, strukturiert und zuverlässig – auch unter Druck. Unternehmerisches Mindset: Du willst direkt mitgestalten, wie KI-gestützte Lohnbuchhaltung aussieht – und mit Softwareentwicklern bauen, was es so noch nicht gibt. Tech-Begeisterung: Du probierst neue Lösungen aktiv aus und siehst Technologie als Hebel – nicht als Bedrohung. Benefits 🧠 Du baust mit, was Steuerberatung morgen ist - KI-gestützte Beratungsformate, die es so noch nicht gibt. Du entscheidest mit, wie Top-Beratung in der Zukunft aussieht 🤝 Steile Lernkurve mit Gründern und Tech-Team - Direkte Zusammenarbeit im Alltag, gegenseitiges Sparring auf Augenhöhe 🚀 Volle Verantwortung ab Tag 1 - Eigene Mandate, Leistungsportfolio, Wachstumsstrategie - du gestaltest mit 🛠️ Modernes Tech-Setup — Digitale Prozesse, KI-gestützte Tools, klare Strukturen 💰 Kompetitives Gehaltspaket 🏠 Hybrides Arbeiten - Homeoffice und Büro flexibel kombinieren 📍 Büro im Herzen Münchens , top angebunden 🎁 3

jobs.title: Fullstack Entwickler mit PHP-Backend – Symfony, RabbitMQ (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wer wir sind Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden. Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen. Deine Aufgaben Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen, eingebettet in deren Teams. Dein Schwerpunkt ist das Backend: Schnittstellen, Datenflüsse zwischen Systemen und die Logik dahinter. Im Frontend packst du mit an, wenn es das Feature braucht. Backend-Entwicklung mit PHP, bevorzugt Symfony REST-APIs entwerfen und mit OpenAPI dokumentieren Systeme über Messaging verbinden: RabbitMQ, Symfony Messenger oder Kafka GitLab-Pipelines aufbauen und pflegen, vom Build bis zum Deployment Code generieren, reviewen und refactoren mit Claude Code, Copilot oder Cursor Abstimmung mit Product Ownern, Frontend und Betrieb Die Einsätze laufen überwiegend remote. Beim Kunden bist du an einzelnen Präsenztagen, zum Beispiel in Berlin an zwei bis drei Tagen im Monat. Wer mag, kommt zusätzlich in eins unserer Büros. Zwang ist das keiner. Wo du landest Je nach Projekt bei Großkonzernen, im öffentlichen Sektor oder bei Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen. Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung. Was du mitbringst Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung als Entwickler, gezählt nach Ausbildung oder Studium. Das erwarten wir: PHP, mindestens drei Jahre produktiv in den letzten fünf Jahren, bevorzugt mit Symfony (Laravel ist auch in Ordnung) REST-API-Design einschließlich OpenAPI CI/CD mit GitLab-Pipelines Message-basierte Architektur mit RabbitMQ oder Vergleichbarem (Symfony Messenger auf AMQP, Kafka) Automatisierte Tests mit PHPUnit, dazu Integrations- und End-to-End-Tests Von Vorteil (kein Muss): LLM-Integration in Anwendungen (RAG, Tool-Calling, Agenten), auch aus einem Nebenprojekt Pimcore 11 oder ein anderes CMS Datenmodellierung mit MariaDB oder MySQL TypeScript mit Vue oder React AWS Echtzeit-Schnittstellen und Datenpipelines Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass du im PHP-Backend sicher bist und dich schnell in neue Stacks reinfindest. Projektsprache ist Deutsch Du arbeitest im Team des Kunden, auf Deutsch, in Meetings und in der Dokumentation. Wir erwarten Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder besser. AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Unsere Kunden erwarten das, und wir arbeiten auch so. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills. Was wir bieten Überwiegend remote, dazu Büro, wenn du magst MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware) Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner Internes Upskilling in AI-Entwicklung Bewerbung Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Nach einer kurzen Video-Frage-Runde (2×90 Sekunden) melden wir uns innerhalb weniger Tage. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Quantum Program & Ecosystemmanager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Schnittstelle zwischen Quanten-Ökosystem, strategischen Formaten & Thought Leadership Über uns: Das Quantum Business Network (QBN) ist ein führendes internationales Industrie-Netzwerk für die Kommerzialisierung, die industrielle und militärische Anwendung sowie die Skalierung von Quantentechnologien. Wir verbinden Industrie, Wissenschaft, Startups, Investment und Politik, um Marktzugänge zu schaffen, Innovationen zu skalieren und die technologische Souveränität zu stärken. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine proaktive und strukturierte Persönlichkeit, die Begeisterung für den Aufbau professioneller Netzwerke mitbringt, wirkungsstarke Formate zum Leben erweckt und dazu beiträgt, unsere strategischen B2B-Services weiter voranzutreiben. Deine Aufgaben Als Quantum Program & Ecosystem Manager bildest du das operative Rückgrat über drei zentrale Säulen hinweg und arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen: Arbeitsgruppen- & Initiativen-Management: Operative Steuerung und Moderation von politik- und wirtschaftsbezogenen Arbeitsgruppen, Leitung von Workshops, Vor- und Nachbereitung von Meetings, Erstellung von Dokumentationen sowie aktive Förderung des Mitglieder-Engagements. Branchenberichte & Policy Papers: Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung von Analyse-Frameworks zur Bewertung technologischer sowie industrieller Trends, Verfassung fundierter Markt- und Branchenberichte sowie Erstellung strategischer Positionspapiere und Präsentationen. Content & Repräsentation: Repräsentation von QBN auf internationalen Konferenzen und Networking-Events als Botschafter für das Netzwerk und unsere Mitglieder. Dein Profil Ausbildung: Master-Abschluss (oder Promotion) in Physik, Quantum Engineering, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten MINT-Fachbereich – oder in Betriebswirtschaftslehre / Volkswirtschaftslehre mit nachweisbarem Fokus auf Deeptech. Berufserfahrung: 1–3 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Initiativen-Management, Cluster-/Netzwerkmanagement, in Startup-Acceleratoren, der B2B-Industrie oder in der Beratung. Branchenverständnis & Leidenschaft: Solides Verständnis für die Auswirkungen von Deeptech- und Quantentechnologien sowie starkes Interesse an deren Schnittstelle zu Wirtschaft, Politik und Verteidigung/Sicherheit (Defence). Arbeitsweise: Sehr strukturiert, zuverlässig und umsetzungsstark im Tagesgeschäft – ein Organisationstalent mit hoher Eigenverantwortung. Kommunikation & Wohnort: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (in Wort und Schrift); souveränes Auftreten gegenüber hochrangigen Stakeholdern aus Industrie, Politik und Forschung. Hauptwohnsitz und Arbeitsort in Deutschland sind zwingend erforderlich. Was wir bieten Hohe Sichtbarkeit & Netzwerk: Direkter Kontakt zu Entscheidungsträgern, Gründern, VCs und Top-Forschern im europäischen und internationalen Deeptech-Ökosystem. Unternehmerisches Wachstum: Die Chance, wirkungsstarke Formate und neue strategische Services von Grund auf aufzubauen, mitzugestalten und zu skalieren – unter direkter Anleitung der Geschäftsführung. Attraktives Paket: Grundgehalt kombiniert mit einem leistungsorientierten Bonusmodell, das deinen Beitrag und unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung neuer Initiativen belohnt. Flexibilität: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und hoher Autonomie. Interessiert? Wenn du die Zukunft des Quanten- und Deeptech-Ökosystems aktiv mitgestalten und Verantwortung für strategische Initiativen übernehmen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung (Lebenslauf, kurzes Anschreiben, Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglicher Eintrittstermin) an jobs(at)qbn(dot)world . jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Platform (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform, powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Our modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. About the role You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor, working directly with our Platform Lead, who sets Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering organisation. It's a small team, so you'll cover a wide surface area, with no dedicated DevOps or QA function to hand work to. This is a high-ownership seat. You'll take on substantial, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives, agree the direction with the Platform Lead, then drive them from first analysis through to completion with real autonomy over how you get there. We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a significant topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role. If you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in.   What you'll  be up to   Designing and building scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. Spotting and scoping problems and initiatives yourself, not just picking up assigned tickets: weighing impact, priority and timing. Contributing to architectural decisions and design discussions, and bringing other teams along. Driving substantial, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, coordinating with stakeholders across engineering. Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that help teams deliver faster and more reliably. Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. Sharing knowledge through code reviews, design reviews and pairing, and helping raise technical standards. Spotting where AI and automation can improve how we build and run software.   Some of the challenges waiting for you   You'll take ownership of one of these as your first initiative, with no other distractions. Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database. Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform. Extracting and reworking common services to get us ready for our next scale level. What you'll  bring to the team   5+ years of backend development experience, with a track record of owning significant technical work from ambiguity through to completion. Substantial hands-on ownership of infrastructure, reliability or performance, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms. We care more about how you think than which stack you've used. Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals and genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). Comfort with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests, as we don't have a dedicated QA function. A project you can talk about in depth: the problem, what you did and the impact it had. Fluent English. Nice to have   Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS or Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. jobs.title: Director Brand Marketing & Community (all genders)
jobs.description: Meet Urban Sports Club We are among the leading platforms for sports and wellness in Europe, dedicated to inspiring people to live active, healthy lives. With just one membership we offer access to thousands of fitness and wellness experiences across the continent. But what truly sets us apart? We believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. If you're curious about how we work, what we value and how you might grow with us, explore our Culture Hub & Career Opportunities . *Big news: Wellhub and Urban Sports Club unite!* Urban Sports Club is now a proud part of Wellhub, creating a global wellbeing ecosystem. Together, we connect 39,000 corporate clients and 97,000 wellness partners across 18 countries, offering millions of people even more ways to stay active and take care of their health.   The opportunity  We look for a visionary Director of Brand & Community to report directly to our CEO . This is an extraordinary opportunity to shape the next chapter of an already immensely strong brand. As we enjoy incredible brand equity and awareness – particularly in our home market of Germany – you won't be starting from zero. Instead, you will inherit a premium, high-performing base to steer our consumer brand into its next major iteration: moving toward a broader, lifestyle and community-driven positioning. A core focus of this role will be emphasizing the "Club" in Urban Sports Club. We are a community-driven concept, not just a utility app for solo check-ins. In this hybrid role, you will sit firmly on both the strategic/conceptual side and the operational frontlines. You will champion the evolution of the brand to maximize consumer appeal, while simultaneously developing and executing the concrete marketing strategies that bring our community vision to life. Your most exciting challenge? Internationalization – translating our proven local formula into scalable, culturally resonant consumer strategies for diverse international markets. What you will do Drive Brand Evolution: Architect the long-term conceptual development and narrative of Urban Sports Club, pivoting the brand toward a holistic, community-centric consumer lifestyle identity. You'll define the brand positioning, value propositions, messaging frameworks and audience strategies in collaboration with our Strategy team. Strengthen the "Club": Ensure campaigns and activations reinforce the community aspect of our brand, creating emotional connections that highlight shared experiences and lifestyle rather than just functional access. We see community as driving both new member acquisition as well as member engagement. Balance Strategy & Execution: Own the brand marketing strategy end-to-end, steering its execution across multi-channel campaigns, PR, Content, and Social Media. Lead Internationalization: Translate, adapt, and scale the core brand strategy across international B2C markets, balancing global consistency with deep local cultural relevance. Steer the Creative Studio & Teams: Oversee and mentor our multi-disciplinary brand teams and internal creative studio, fostering innovation, efficiency, and high-impact creative excellence. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary strategic brand stakeholder across the organization, collaborating closely with all marketing leaders to align brand priorities with business objectives. Insights & Budget Management: Efficiently manage the global brand budget while monitoring key health metrics (awareness, sentiment, share of voice) to turn consumer insights into optimized campaign performance. What you will need to succeed 10+ years of experience leading brand management, marketing, or integrated communications, ideally within lifestyle, community or fast-paced B2C consumer industries. Role overview Complex merchants can create complex financial crime risks. Their corporate structures, operating models and control environments may span entities, jurisdictions and teams. When concerns emerge, effective action depends on more than identifying the issue: someone must bring the right people together, agree a credible response, and keep remediation moving until it is complete. As Financial Crime Oversight & Remediation Manager, you will provide that ownership. You will coordinate targeted oversight of higher-risk or strategically important merchant relationships, helping turn concerns into clear, proportionate and evidenced plans. You will work across Compliance, Financial Crime Investigations, onboarding, commercial and operational teams, and, where appropriate, directly with merchants. Your judgement will matter: you will need to know when a proposed control or remediation is credible, when evidence is insufficient, and when an issue needs escalation. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines financial crime compliance expertise with strong delivery discipline. You will help address issues early, support defensible decisions, and give complex remediation the structure and follow-through it needs. What you’ll do Own targeted remediation coordination. For complex merchant concerns, bring together the relevant internal teams, clarify the problem and desired outcomes, agree accountable owners and milestones, and maintain a practical plan through to closure. Track dependencies and slippage, challenge gaps, escalate material blockers and confirm that completion is supported by evidence. Coordinate Compliance-imposed conditions. Track material financial-crime conditions attached to product, market or other approval decisions. Work with the relevant Compliance and business owners to confirm accountability, milestones and evidence of completion; identify slippage or gaps; challenge whether evidence demonstrates the condition has been met; and escalate overdue or inadequately evidenced actions through the agreed governance route. The relevant delivery owner remains accountable for implementing the condition. Coordinate enhanced oversight of merchants. Support a structured watch-list approach for merchants whose risk or control environment warrants closer attention than routine, risk-tiered monitoring, but where immediate termination or a formal investigation is not necessarily the right response. jobs.description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. The role We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team. Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects. Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it, and drive their implementation, so our scientists and models can rely on it. You will build this hand in hand with our data engineering team, keeping our omics infrastructure consistent with the rest of the company’s stack. You will report to the Head of Computational Biology. Experience with omics data is a strong plus, not a prerequisite. If you come from the conventional tabular data world and want to master data that is massive, multi-layered and regularly reprocessed, this role is built for you. What you will do Design and build the omics data architecture. Together with our data engineering team, define and evolve how omics data is stored as the corpus grows: what lives in a database, what stays in columnar files on S3, and how it all fits the company’s stack. Guarantee reliable ingestion. Make sure every new batch of processed omics data (variant calls, expression, CNV, QC metrics, sample and sequencing tracking) lands reliably and consistently with our data model definition. Build and maintain the omics data model. Maintain a curated reference layer as the single source of truth, keep model-ready datasets derived from it separate, and track lineage between the two so every model input can be traced back to its source. Make the data easy to use. Build and evolve the access layer so scientists and models get what they need for client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D, without writing joins or asking someone. Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering (or equivalent experience) Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for data pipelines and code libraries. Deep relational database expertise: schema design, partitioning, indexing, query plans, migrations on a live data

Western countries have seen healthspan flatline for years, meaning we live longer, but not better. 46% of Europeans report mental health issues. Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé. Intégré.e au sein de l'équipe SQA, vous prendrez en main un banc de test physique déjà en production : il valide chaque nuit l'installation, la mise à jour et la configuration d'une vingtaine de modèles de produits Withings (balances, montres, tensiomètres…), pilotés en UART et relais, intégrés à notre CI Jenkins. Ce stage a pour but de penser, concevoir et produire une version améliorée permettant d'automatiser les interactions physiques — prendre une mesure, monter sur une balance, porter une montre, appuyer sur un bouton, vérifier ce que l'écran du dispositif affiche — afin de convertir en tests automatiques (python) les cas de tests exécutés à la main. En forte interaction avec la QA Firmware, vos principales responsabilités incluront : - Automatiser les mesures simulables : injection de mesures en dblib côté firmware, synchronisation réelle, vérification dans l'app. - Explorer l'émulation de device : étudier et prototyper la simulation complète d'un produit sur Raspberry Pi (comportement BLE/Wi-Fi, cycle d'installation, génération de mesures) - Étendre la couverture du banc existant : nouveaux modèles de produits, nouveaux scénarios (installation, firmware, synchronisation) - Concevoir, modéliser et réaliser les jig de tests : impression 3D de supports et d'actionneurs, pilotage de relais et d'instrumentation série, lecture de l'état des dispositifs (écran, LED). - Développer et maintenir les scripts d'automatisation en Python (Appium, pytest) qui orchestrent app mobile (iOS et Android), backend et instrumentation physique. - Intégrer chaque nouveau scénario à la CI Jenkins pour qu'il tourne chaque nuit, et mesurer la réduction du volume de tests manuels qu'il permet. - Travailler avec les outils d'aujourd'hui : l'équipe développe avec un harness d'agents de code (Claude Code…) — pipeline de génération de tests, revues assistées ; vous l'utiliserez et contribuerez à l'améliorer. - Analyser les résultats, remonter les bugs et documenter les composants hardware et software ; participer aux revues de code. Requirements Vous êtes étudiant.e en dernière année d'une formation Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur ou université) et recherchez un stage de fin d'études ; Une excellente maîtrise de Python est indispensable, notamment pour l'automatisation et l'interfaçage avec le hardware (ex : pyserial) ; Des connaissances en conception mécanique et/ou en impression 3D (ex : FreeCAD, Fusion 360, Cura) seraient un atout majeur — le jig est autant mécanique que logiciel ; Des bases en électronique (schémas simples, capteurs, relais, UART) seraient un plus ; Une curiosité pour les agents de code (Claude Code, Codex…) est un plus ; Vous êtes à l'aise avec les environnements MacOS et Linux ; Vous êtes passionné.e par les produits high-tech innovants, l'IoT et les enjeux de la qualité logicielle et hardware ; Vous êtes curieux.se, rigoureux.se, autonome, force de proposition et vous disposez d'une bonne capacité d'adaptation pour progresser dans un environnement en constante évolution ; Vous êtes à l'aise pour communiquer vos idées et travailler en équipe ; Vous maîtrisez l'anglais technique (lecture et écriture de code et de documentation). Benefits Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est : Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambiti

More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management. We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently. As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A , Finance Operations , and Procurement , each with its own ressources. Today, the team consists of 2 people but are actively recruiting toward a target organization of 7. Most of it is still to be hired and built — by you. You will report to Quentin , our COO. ✨ Why this role is special You build the function instead of inheriting it. The target organization — FP&A, Finance Operations, Procurement — exists on paper and almost nothing of it is built. You recruit the team, set the standards, and decide how Finance operates for the next stage of the company. The role is designed to grow into VP Finance once the function is in place. You get a genuinely 360 scope. Planning, accounting close, cash, financing, multi-entity structuring, procurement, and investor relations all sit with you — across multiple business lines, in France, Spain, and the US, with more markets coming. Very few finance leaders get that full surface at this stage. You join a profitable company that is moving fast. Joko is already profitable and keeps growing quickly, with new business lines and countries opening. You build a finance function for a company on the offensive, not one managing a slowdown. jobs.title: Engineering Director - Building Automation
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Engineering Director to lead the engineering organization for Priva Building Automation and drive the successful development and delivery of our products. Who are we?   Priva is a dynamic and innovative multinational company with 16 branch offices on all continents and almost 600 dedicated colleagues. We are passionate about tackling global challenges like food security, energy transition, and water management. Our mission, "Creating a climate for growth," means we aim to empower our customers to thrive and make the world a better place through our solutions in horticulture and building automation. Building Automation is one of Priva's four business verticals, delivering the advanced climate control technologies behind comfortable, energy-efficient buildings. As the Engineering Director, you own end-to-end development, delivery, engineering quality and engineering performance. You are ultimately accountable for the domain’s engineering performance: operational excellence, product quality, sustainable technical decisions, organizational capability, and budget. The role sits within Priva's Product Development organization and reports directly to the CPTO. You lead the Building Automation engineering organization, spanning hardware, embedded and cloud engineering, quality, and project and delivery management. Together with the Product Director, you balance customer value, commercial priorities, technical sustainability, quality, and delivery risk. What you own   Engineering strategy for the domain: Define the engineering and technical strategy aligned with company and product strategy. Technical leadership:  You help teams navigate hard technical problems, guide trade-off discussions, and resolve cross-team impediments. You support architects, team leads, and engineers in reaching effective and sustainable technical decisions, when required. Delivery : Own the predictable delivery of product outcomes, balancing speed, quality and long-term sustainability. jobs.description: Werkstudent Recruitment (Nederlandstalig) — Den Haag of Berlijn, hybride (v/m/x) Wil je weten hoe recruitment echt werkt? Bij Eye ga je niet alleen cv's archiveren. Over Eye Eye Security maakt cybersecurity van topniveau, met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering, bereikbaar voor elk bedrijf in Europa, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. We zijn met ruim 190 collega's, met ons hoofdkantoor in Den Haag en een kantoor in Berlijn. Ons team komt uit de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. Je helpt onze recruiters kandidaten te vinden voor lastig in te vullen functies Je screent sollicitaties voor onze junior functies, waarvan veel in het Nederlands Je maakt van recruitmentdata heldere rapportages waar het team en managers echt iets aan hebben Je verbetert hoe we ons ATS gebruiken en houdt de data op orde Je brengt structuur in onze recruitmentkennis, te beginnen met alle vacatureteksten op één plek Je zorgt dat sollicitatiegesprekken soepel verlopen: plannen, afstemmen en contact met kandidaten Je helpt onze contacten met hogescholen en universiteiten op te bouwen De functie is nieuw en groeit mee met jou en met wat het team het hardst nodig heeft. Wie ben jij? Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en redt je goed in het Engels Je zit in het derde of vierde jaar van je hbo- of wo-opleiding en kunt 20 uur per week werken, waarvan 2 à 3 dagen op ons kantoor in Den Haag of Berlijn Je hebt minstens een half jaar administratieve of kantoorervaring (een bestuursjaar telt ook mee) en je bent handig met Excel Je wilt een carrière in recruitment opbouwen en bent benieuwd hoe het vak in elkaar zit Je pakt dingen zelf op: je ziet wat er moet gebeuren, zoekt hulp als je die nodig hebt en stelt goede vragen Mooi meegenomen Je vindt het leuk om met data te werken, of wilt daar beter in worden Je hebt al wat ervaring met recruitment, HR of een ATS Wat krijg je? Vanaf de eerste week echte verantwoordelijkheid, met een recruiter naast je van wie je het vak leert Een duidelijke kans om door te groeien naar junior recruiter Flexibele uren die passen bij je studie, en hybride werken Een team dat successen samen viert, van maandelijkse teamactiviteiten tot onze jaarlijkse "Eye-cation" Over Eye Security Eye Security biedt cybersecurity met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering aan organisaties in heel Europa. Ons hoofdkantoor staat in Nederland en we zijn gegroeid naar ruim 170 medewerkers. We blijven internationaal uitbreiden. We combineren geavanceerde technologie met praktische expertise om cyberdreigingen in realtime te detecteren, erop te reageren en de schade te herstellen. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!</p></div><p>We are looking for a Director, Strategic Sales to join our team of creatives, engineers, marketers, and business leaders. With this role, you'll help shape a sales org still early in its growth trajectory. You'll lead a team focused on our largest clients in driving meaningful relationships that add value to the customer experience and revenue to our bottom line.</p> <p>Figma is growing and moving fast. Our next team member will be adaptable, comfortable embracing change, a true team-player, and love working with our growing footprint of Fortune 1000 customers. You won't be alone! Figma has an incredible team and you'll work closely with other groups including Support, Design, Engineering, Product Marketing, and Community. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: About GeneralMind GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics. Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments. We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows. About the role We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer who treats LLMs as production software, not as magic. Someone who can own the agent layer of our platform end to end - from prompt and context design, through tool use and orchestration, to evals, reliability, and continuous improvement in live customer environments. This role sits at the intersection of two things that are rarely mastered together: shipping LLM-powered systems that actually work in messy enterprise reality, and the discipline of a real engineer - evals, observability, cost, latency, failure modes. Models get smarter every month. What stays scarce is the engineering judgment to make them reliably useful on top of SAP, Oracle, and the mess of real operational data. You will be a senior individual contributor working directly with the founders. The person in this role won’t be handed a roadmap - they’ll help define it, and build the AI practice around it. What you will do AI Ownership Own the agent layer end-to-end: prompt and context design, tool use, orchestration, evals, and long-term technical direction. Be the person who understands why an agent made the decision it made - and who other engineers come to when a model behaves in ways they can’t explain. Set the bar on how we build with LLMs: eval-driven development, context engineering, structured outputs, cost and latency discipline. Make foundational decisions with conviction - which model, which pattern, which guardrail - document the reasoning, and evolve them as the system grows. LLM Systems in Production Design agents that survive real enterprise environments: ambiguous inputs, flaky upstream systems, exception cases that weren’t in anyone’s spec. Build the eval harness that lets us ship confidently: offline evals, online evals, regression suites, human-in-the-loop review. Think in failure modes: hallucinations, silent drift, prompt injection, tool misuse. Build the detection before you need it. Own cost and latency as first-class product requirements, not afterthoughts. Agent & Context Engineering Design agent architectures that compose cleanly: tool selection, state, memory, planning, escalation. Build the context layer that makes agents actually useful on top of SAP and Oracle data - retrieval, grounding, schema awareness, auditability. Evolve agents without breaking live customer deployments; manage prompt and model versioning with intention. Know when the right answer is a bigger model, a better prompt, a fine-tune, a tool, or just classical code. Reliability & Systems Thinking Detect regressions in agent behavior before a customer does; build the evals and observability to catch them early. Own the operational posture of the AI systems you ship: alerting, runbooks, replay, on-call readiness. Identify structural debt in prompts, pipelines, and context before it compounds; refactor with thought. What we are looking for Experience: 6+ years building production software, with clear ownership of LLM-powered systems in real customer environments - not demos, not notebooks. LLM depth: Non-negotiable. You’ve shipped agents or LLM features that run on live traffic. You have strong opinions about prompting, context, tool use, structured outputs, and what breaks in production. Evals as a first instinct: You don’t ship LLM code without a way to measure it. You’ve built eval pipe

jobs.description: About Sona Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here ( https://www.sona.ai/careers ). About the Role We're hiring a Founding Account Executive to win Sona's first customers in Italy and open the market for us. This is a senior, seller-first role, and you'll run every conversation with prospects in Italian, from the first call to the close. Our expansion into Europe is starting now and ramps up through 2027 across key markets. Italy is one of them, and you'll own the go-to-market launch there. Colleagues across Sona will be running the product, operations and other launch activities, so your focus is winning customers, building partnerships and creating the collateral to sell. With no sales team in market yet, you'll work with less support than a typical AE, and the team around you will grow as the market does. Day to day, you'll decide which Retail and Hospitality accounts to go after, from mid-market through to enterprise, and run consultative sales conversations yourself. You'll also build what a new market needs, including partnerships and Italian-language collateral. The platform is already localised for Italy, and you'll have product and solutions support. It's early, and the ground will shift as we learn what works. If you want a structured environment with lots of support around you, this won't be the right fit. If you want to shape how Sona sells in Italy from the start, it could be exactly that. The role is office-based in London, with travel to Italy as needed. Responsibilities Lead the go-to-market launch in Italy and win Sona's first customers, taking each deal from first conversation to close. Build your own pipeline across Retail and Hospitality, from mid-market to enterprise. Run strategic, consultative sales conversations in Italian. Build and run partnerships that open doors in the Italian market. Create the collateral Sona needs to sell in Italy. Work with Sona's Strategy and Expansion Lead on where to focus and how to approach the market. Feed what you learn from the market back to our Commercial and Product teams. Travel to Italy as the role requires. Requirements You're a native Italian speaker, comfortable selling and negotiating in Italian, with fluent English for working with colleagues in London. You have a senior Account Executive track record of winning new business, ideally across mid-market and enterprise deals. You have a founder mentality. You take ownership, make decisions with limited information, and are happy building without a playbook. You're strategic and consultative in how you sell, and you work well independently with less support than most AEs get. You're comfortable creating partnerships and collateral from scratch. You're based in London, or able to be, and happy to travel to Italy as the role needs. Strongly preferred: Spanish, French or German as an additional language. It doesn't replace Italian. jobs.title: Regional Director of Operations, UK, Europe and Africa
jobs.description: Regional Director of Operations, UK, Europe and Africa Kenyon International Emergency Services, part of the TrustFlight Group Bracknell, United Kingdom | Full time, permanent | Competitive salary and benefits package When the worst happens, families need someone they can trust. Lead that response. When an aircraft is lost, a ship is in distress or a community is struck by disaster, families are suddenly facing the hardest days of their lives. They need answers, they need to be treated with dignity, and they need to know that the people they have lost are being cared for. For more than a century, Kenyon International Emergency Services has been the organisation that airlines, governments and major companies call on to make sure that happens. We are looking for a senior crisis leader to direct that response across the UK, Europe and Africa. This is a role for someone who has stood in the room when it mattered, who leads with calm authority, and who believes that how an organisation treats the bereaved and the injured says everything about its character. About Kenyon Kenyon provides emergency planning, family assistance, humanitarian support and recovery services to clients around the world, drawing on a network of more than 2,500 trained responders who can be mobilised at short notice into any jurisdiction. Our clients rely on us to keep their promises to the people affected by an incident, and we hold ourselves to that standard every day, not only on the day of an activation. Kenyon is part of the TrustFlight Group, an aviation safety and compliance technology business. That gives Kenyon something unusual in this sector: a world class technology team working alongside it, and a genuine commitment to using AI to make crisis response faster, better informed and more humane. Our values are simple and we mean them: integrity, and a customer first attitude in everything we do. The role Kenyon operates a two hub leadership model. You will lead the Bracknell hub, with regional accountability for operational delivery, readiness, contracted offices and relationships across the UK, Europe and Africa. Your peer, the Regional Director of Operations in Vancouver, leads the Americas and Asia Pacific. Together you share accountability for the readiness and quality of Kenyon’s response worldwide. Senior Incident Director for activations Senior on call duty is shared between the two Directors on a fixed twelve hour rota, with a structured handover at each change of duty, so that cover is continuous around the clock and neither Director works through their own night. Your window runs from approximately 06:00 to 18:00 UK time. When an incident arises during your window, wherever in the world it occurs, you take up the role of Senior Incident Director. You will have the authority to set the deployment posture, commit responders and stand the organisation up or down without further approval. Where a client requires it, you will deploy as their strategic point of contact, leading the response on their behalf at the most demanding moments an organisation can face, including mass casualty, government led and politically sensitive events. Major activations are infrequent, and Kenyon holds its capability through a surge based model rather than a large permanent workforce. Your judgement of regional readiness, kept current every week of the year, is what makes that model work. What you will lead ·       Regional readiness and response. Maintain and continuously measure activation readiness across the UK, Europe and Africa, and develop the procedures, protocols and contingency plans that underpin it. ·       Your team and offices. Line manage the Regional Operations Manager in Bracknell, run the Bracknell hub and its regional operations as one regional function, and hold contracted offices to defined standards through quarterly reviews and an annual assessment. ·     &nbs

jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY . The Role We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion. This is a hands-on builder role, not a traditional RevOps support function. You'll work like a product engineer for GTM: find the biggest constraint on growth, turn a messy commercial problem into a working system, ship it quickly and improve it using real results. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be able to build with Salesforce, Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools rather than waiting for someone else to do it. You'll also be Kernel's own internal customer , using Kernel to build an AI-native revenue engine, pressure-test the product in real workflows and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering.
