jobs.title: Junior Compute Architect
jobs.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. About the Hardware organisation at Fractile Processor Architecture sits within Fractile’s hardware organisation, which owns everything from compute engine definition and ISA design through memory hierarchies, on-chip interconnects, and the path from early architectural exploration through to tapeout and post-silicon validation. Architecture at Fractile isn’t a paper exercise — it’s built in constant collaboration with logical design, physical design, and verification teams, so that every architectural decision is grounded in what will actually perform in working silicon. About the team and role As an Early Career Processor Architect, you’ll join our architecture team to learn how to define the compute engines, ISA definitions and programming models that sit at the heart of our silicon. Working closely with senior architects and our logical design, physical design, and verification teams, you’ll get real exposure to performance modelling, specification writing, bottleneck analysis, and pre- and post-silicon validation — with experienced architects mentoring you as you build toward owning more of this yourself. About you We’re looking for someone with a strong foundational understanding of computer or processor architecture — built through coursework, personal projects, internships, placements, or research — who’s genuinely curious about performance and power trade-offs and eager to learn how to navigate them. You don’t need prior industry experience as a Processor Architect; what matters is real hands-on exposure to processor or accelerator design, through a final-year project, FPGA build, RISC-V implementation, internship, or research, plus a comfort working across disciplines and a track record of thriving in ambiguity and fast iteration. Key Requirements A degree (BEng, MEng, MSc or equivalent) in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. A solid foundational understanding of computer/processor architecture, including matrix- and vector-centric floating-point arithmetic and memory hierarchies, gained through study, projects, internships, or research. Some exposure to RTL design concepts and how physical design constraints feed back into architectural choices — academic or internship-level experience is fine. Any hands-on exposure to architectural performance modelling tools (gem5, SystemC, or custom cycle-accurate simulators), compiler/toolchain interactions, or AI acceleration/vector-matrix compute, through study or projects, is highly valued. A clear communicator, comfortable working across architecture, modelling, implementation, verification, and software teams, who thrives in ambiguity and fast iteration. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Security Engineering
jobs.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. The role We build the control chain that powers on, monitors, updates, and protects devices and racks across bare metal, RTOS, and embedded Linux. We also build the communication mechanisms that connect devices to each other and to the host. Security runs through all of it. A chain of trust from the hardware up to the rack management plane: the root of trust each controller boots from, the signed updates that reach the fleet safely, the identity that lets a device prove what it is, the authenticated channels the controllers and devices talk over, and the runtime protections that keep the host Linux kernel and the on-die firmware trustworthy long after boot. These are the layers that let operators rely on the hardware. You’d be deeply involved in that security across the chain, making it real in software. You’ll work hand in hand with our architecture and hardware teams, bringing the software and system-level view: turning threat models into concrete mechanisms in bare metal, RTOS, and Linux, then designing, prototyping, and validating them. Some of the calls in this model are still open, and you’ll help shape them. We want engineers who understand security from the inside out. You know how the root of trust, boot chain, key hierarchy, and secure interconnects actually work under the hood, not just how to switch them on. In this role, the security of your software solutions depends entirely on how well you understand the hardware beneath it. Some of the protections we rely on live in silicon, some in software, and part of the skill is knowing which belongs where. We’re looking for people who know both sides well enough to build the mechanisms that close whole classes of bugs by design. We’re not heavy on levels here! Whether you’d call yourself senior, staff, principal, or lead, what matters is depth of security judgement, system-level experience, and working well with the engineers around you. If you’ve worked deep in the security of real systems and like to get your hands on the code and the systems around it, we’d like to hear from you. What you’ll do: Shape the security of the control chain (device, board, chassis, and rack controllers): threat models, trust boundaries, and a coherent secure-by-design approach across all platforms Design and help build secure boot and the root of trust on each controller: verified/measured boot, signing and verification, anti-rollback, and locking down debug and privileged access in production Secure the interconnects, between controllers and between devices and the host, with authentication, integrity, and additional protections where needed Design and build the cryptographic mechanisms: key hierarchies, provisioning and storage, device identity, and remote attestation so the fleet can prove what it’s running Make firmware updates safe end to end: signed images, rollbac

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance. As Senior Product Manager in our Pro Business Unit, you'll own the mid-market product line end to end. You'll lead a "pod" - a small, cross-functional team of a PM or designer, and 2-3 full-stack engineers - through the whole cycle: identifying the problem, shaping the solution, building it, shipping it, and measuring the result. You're the single point of accountability for that team. The role blends product management, product design, and engineering judgment, all supported by AI tools. So we welcome candidates from a PM, design, or engineering background, as long as you're comfortable working across all three. You'll report into the Product Engineering director within the BU, alongside other pods led by senior PMs, designers, or engineering managers. Your impact at Brevo: Gather client signals and usage data and translate them into clearly defined problems, then shape the pitch — appetite, solution, risks and no-gos — and defend it at the betting table. Run the build cycle against the pitch, using lightweight written status artefacts rather than recurring status meetings, and adjust scope rather than extend timelines. Agree on one or two measurable outcomes before the build begins, then deliver a clear post-launch verdict: continue, adjust, or discontinue. Own the launch: run the beta programme, equip PMM for go-to-market, and get Sales, CSM and Support ready ahead of release. Be the pod's single point of contact for the wider BU — surfacing risks early, coordinating with peer Pod Leaders, and applying AI tools by default across discovery, prototyping and analysis. Who you are: You have a relevant background as a PM or Product Designer, or Lead Engineer — no single track is preferred. You can own an experience end-to-end: framing user problems, making interface/interaction decisions, and producing or validating prototypes (Figma and design-system literacy required). You have a go-getter, get-things-done mentality: you take initiative, push through ambiguity, and drive things to completion rather than waiting to be told. You can write and defend a complete pitch: problem, appetite, sketch, rabbit holes, no-gos and success metrics. You have a track record of shipping against a committed appetite using lightweight, async cadence artefacts (e.g. hill charts) rather than heavyweight Scrum rituals. You're comfortable pulling and interpreting usage data (Amplitude, funnel, retention) and running discovery interviews to turn signals into problem statements. jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect & Developer – Marketing Automation
jobs.description: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow,  Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.   Position Description We are seeking a deeply technical  Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine. Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving. We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure. What you will do Data Architecture & Engineering Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free. Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs. ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions. Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency.   Technical Customization & Custom Development Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines. Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages. Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks.   API & Ecosystem Integrations Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform. Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync. Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers.   Platform Operations & System Health Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime. Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM). Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure. Experience and qualifications Core Technical Competencies Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning. Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP AP

jobs.title: IT System Engineer (w/m/d), 80–100 %
jobs.description: Kunden begleiten. Lösungen umsetzen. Verantwortung übernehmen. Du willst die IT deiner Kunden nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern verstehen, weiterentwickeln und verantworten? Bei Dukers betreust du eigene Kundenumgebungen von A bis Z – mit einem Team im Rücken, das sein Wissen teilt und bei kniffligen Fragen zusammensteht. Über Dukers Dukers ist ein Spin-off der Swisscom mit Sitz in St. Gallen. Wir planen, implementieren und betreiben die IT von Organisationen, die ihre Informatik in verlässliche Hände geben wollen. Unsere Kunden erhalten eine Lösung aus einer Hand: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerk, Server, Cloud-Dienste und Kommunikation werden von uns aufgebaut, laufend überwacht, aktuell gehalten und abgesichert. Die Verantwortung für den Betrieb liegt bei uns – mit festen Ansprechpersonen, die die Umgebung ihrer Kunden kennen. Besondere Tiefe haben wir in Cloud-Infrastrukturen und UCC, gestützt auf starke Partnerschaften mit Swisscom und Microsoft. Unser Team besteht aus Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung – mit den Standards eines grossen Anbieters und der Verbindlichkeit eines Partners, der seine Kunden persönlich kennt. jobs.title: Consultant senior / Manager - Conseil en transformation, organisation et gestion de projet

Depuis 2025, nous pratiquons le conseil augmenté : l'IA nous sert à comprendre mieux, à aller plus loin, pas seulement à produire plus vite. Le cabinet est en pleine croissance : de nouvelles directions nous confient leurs enjeux et un deuxième bureau ouvre à Lausanne. Nous cherchons deux personnalités prêtes à rejoindre cette aventure humaine : une équipe dynamique et engagée, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez contribuer au développement du cabinet et tracer votre propre parcours. Ce que vous ferez Vous rejoignez le cabinet comme consultant-e senior ou manager, selon votre expérience. Comprendre avant de proposer. Lire la situation du client, ses acteurs et ses non-dits, avant d'arriver en séance. Résoudre le bon problème. Remettre en cause la commande quand elle ne vise pas le vrai sujet, et défendre une recommandation engagée. Co-construire et faire avancer. Apporter tôt une première version, la faire travailler par le client jusqu'à ce qu'il en soit co-auteur, et animer seul-e des séances, y compris sur des sujets complexes, dans des environnements exigeants et avec des parties prenantes aux sensibilités diverses. Créer de la valeur pour le client. Mieux comprendre, aller plus loin dans l'analyse et concrétiser : ce qui compte, ce sont les progrès durables que le client constate dans son organisation. Faire grandir le cabinet. Transmettre, challenger et accepter de l'être. Deux points d'entrée, selon votre expérience : Manager (dès 10 ans d'expérience). Architecte de mission dès votre arrivée : vous cadrez et pilotez des mandats de bout en bout, et vous encadrez un ou deux consultants en continuant à produire. Vous prenez part à la conduite du cabinet : méthodes, recrutement, capitalisation. Trajectoire explicite vers un rôle où vous portez le résultat et la croissance de plusieurs comptes. Consultant-e senior (dès 5 ans d'expérience). Autonome sur un périmètre cadré, vous menez vos entretiens et ateliers seul-e ou en équipe, et vous êtes une référence en conseil augmenté. C'est l'utiliser pour comprendre mieux, sans jamais laisser la production avancer plus vite que la compréhension. Le test est simple : qu'avez-vous fait du temps que l'IA a libéré ? Plus de livrables, c'est de la sous-traitance à une machine. Plus de présence chez le client et plus de profondeur d'analyse, c'est du conseil augmenté. Ce que nous cherchons Un master ou un diplôme d'ingénieur, et cinq à quinze ans d'expérience en conseil en organisation, stratégie, conduite du changement ou pilotage de programmes. Une pratique réelle du conseil augmenté : vous savez dire ce que vous avez écarté dans une réponse de l'IA et pourquoi, et vous refusez de produire ce que vous n’assumez pas. La capacité à trancher avec une information incomplète, et à ajuster ce choix en avançant, à mesure que la situation se précise. De la fiabilité et de la droiture : vous parlez franchement et vous tenez parole. Pour le point d'entrée Manager : des mandats menés de bout en bout, des consultants que vous avez fait grandir, et des relations de confiance avec vos clients. Maîtrise parfaite du français ou équivalent, excellente plume, anglais courant, allemand un atout. Le tissu romand vous est familier. jobs.title: Senior Stack Scientist
jobs.description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy. As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance. Key Responsibilities Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks. Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles. Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance. Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams. Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies. Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production. Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression. Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners. Skills and Experience Required PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field. 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred). Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression. Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols. Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms. Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar). Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment. Management experience English is mandatory; French or German is a plus. jobs.title: Senior Implementatiemanager Sociaal Domein    |   Gemeente Den Haag
jobs.description: De opdracht   Van veranderkundig advies naar daadwerkelijke verandering. Daar ligt jouw opdracht. Voor twee veranderopgaven binnen het sociaal domein van de gemeente Den Haag zoeken we een ervaren senior implementatiemanager die veranderkundige expertise combineert met implementatiekracht . Ben jij een ervaren implementatiemanager die beweging weet te creëren in complexe maatschappelijke opgaven? Kun jij veranderkundige inzichten verbinden aan concrete resultaten en beschik je over de kracht om veranderingen daadwerkelijk te laten landen in de praktijk? Breng jij structuur en voortgang, zie je patronen en heb je oog voor belangen, krijg je mensen in beweging en kun je tegelijkertijd het eigenaarschap van de lijn versterken? Dan ben jij de senior implementatiemanager die we zoeken voor de ondersteuning van de teams Wet Maatschappelijke Ondersteuning (Wmo) en Jeugdgezondheidszorg (JGZ) binnen het Sociaal Domein. Er liggen twee uitdagende opdrachten waarbij organisatieontwikkeling, cultuurverandering en implementatie hand in hand gaan, daarnaast ben jij ook in de lead voor een pilot passend bij de twee opdrachten. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Implementatiemanager begeleid je complexe verandertrajecten van ontwerp naar uitvoering. Je brengt structuur, regie en voortgang aan in trajecten waarin al denkwerk is verricht, maar waar de daadwerkelijke implementatie en borging nog vorm moet krijgen. Je werkt nauw samen met opdrachtgevers, managementteams, medewerkers en interne adviseurs. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat plannen niet op papier blijven staan, maar worden vertaald naar concrete veranderingen in werkwijzen, processen, gedrag en samenwerking. Je: ·       brengt regie, structuur, tempo en doe-kracht in de verander- en implementatietrajecten; ·       ontwikkelt en begeleidt implementatieaanpakken die bijdragen aan duurzame verandering; ·       hebt sterke veranderkundige vaardigheden en het vermogen om gedrag, cultuur en leiderschap bespreekbaar te maken;  ·       hebt bewezen implementatiekracht : je weet veranderingen te vertalen naar concrete acties, resultaten en borging;  ·       hebt ervaring met transitievraagstukken en het begeleiden van organisaties in verandering; ·       adviseert over risico's, aanpak en passende veranderinterventies; ·       stimuleert bewustwording, dialoog, eigenaarschap en samenwerking; ·       maakt verschillende perspectieven en patronen zichtbaar en bespreekbaar; ·       ontwikkelt praktische tools en werkvormen die de verandering ondersteunen; ·       bewaakt voortgang en resultaten en stuurt bij waar nodig. Je weet daarbij effectief te schakelen tussen denken en doen, richting geven en ruimte bieden, tempo maken en reflecteren . Naast de twee veranderopgaven ben je in de lead voor de pilot rondom implementatie- en transitiemanagement, waar deze opdracht de input voor levert voor de afdeling Opgaven & Ontwikkeling . Op basis van je ervaringen binnen de twee teams (WMO en JGZ) breng je in kaart welke expertise, rollen en capaciteit nodig zijn om dergelijke veranderopgaven in de toekomst goed te ondersteunen. Jouw formele opdrachtgever is één van de managers van het team Organisatieontwikkeling voor dit deel van  jouw opdracht. Wie zoeken wij? Je bent een stevige, zelfstandige en resultaatgerichte professional die complexe veranderopgaven kan doorgronden én realiseren. Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen management en medewerkers, creëert draagvlak en bent organisatiesensitief. Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van organisatieontwikkeling, verandermanagement en implementatiemanagement. We zoeken iemand die veranderkundige scherpte combineert met implementatiekracht en management en teams help

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner
jobs.description: We are hiring a Senior Product Owner who gets energy from structure, flow and a perfectly organised backlog. Someone who wants to make sure great ideas actually reach healthcare professionals through product developments. Our Mission Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App, we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere. Our product and development team is growing fast. Our Product Lead, a former nurse, owns the what and the why: our users, the roadmap and experiments. To keep up with the pace, we’re looking for someone who owns the how and the when: turning that roadmap into well-structured, realistic and predictable delivery, together with our development team leads. Your Role As Senior Product Owner at Attendi, you will: Translate roadmap items, experiments and MVPs into epics and user stories, with clear acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements (performance, security, privacy, platforms). Own the development backlog in Jira: clear, up to date and one to two sprints ahead with work that’s ready to build. Set up and guard our Definition of Ready and Definition of Done. Prepare and lead refinement and sprint planning with our dev team leads. Propose 6-week cycle goals and sprint goals, based on capacity, dependencies, risk and effort. Propose the balance between features, bugs, tech debt and maintenance. Be the first point of contact for developers on tickets, and handle small scope questions yourself. Spot blockers, risks and delays early and solve them with the dev leads. Help turn uncertain AI work into small, measurable experiments. Accept delivered work, prepare phased rollouts and pilots, and write release notes for sales, implementation and support. Make sure our requirements are traceable from requirement to story, test and release, as required for our medical device (MDR) certification. Align technically with EHR vendors and partners on integrations, APIs and releases. Make progress visible with Jira dashboards and delivery metrics. You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following: 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in software product teams. Strong command of Scrum and agile delivery, and you know when to adapt it. Technical enough to discuss solutions with engineers, understand trade-offs and help make realistic estimates. You keep the customer at the centre of the backlog, and link technical work to what users need. You love structure: a clear backlog, a steady rhythm and predictable delivery give you energy. jobs.title: UX Product Designer
jobs.description: We are hiring a UX Designer who loves turning real user problems into clear, safe and well-tested designs, and who wants to shape how healthcare professionals work with AI every day. Our Mission Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App (web and mobile), we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere. Design is central to this vision. Our users are care professionals working with clients, not behind a desk. Every flow we build needs to be simple, fast and safe to use. And because the Attendi App is being certified as a medical device (MDR), we don’t just design what feels intuitive, we prove that users understand and use it as intended. This isn’t about making it as easy as possible to order a pizza. It’s about how a care professional can receive AI-generated advice safely, and make sure they check what matters before they rely on it. Your Role As a UX Designer at Attendi, you will: Translate user research into user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs for the Attendi App. Work closely with our UX researcher, who uncovers user needs in the field, and turn those insights into the right solution. Visit care organisations to test your designs with healthcare professionals: does this solution fit the problem we observed? Design for safety in an AI product: identify where users could misuse or over-trust AI output, and design features that mitigate that risk. Run usability studies as part of our MDR certification, through simulations, observation or A/B tests, and document what you tested and learned. Work in two lanes: fast shipping of new features, and careful, well-documented work on our medical device track. Work closely with the product owner, developers and our compliance team to get designs into production. Help mature our design system in Figma. You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following: 2-4 years of experience as a UX or product designer in a product team, working in sprints. Experience with B2B SaaS products. You start with questions, not solutions: who is the user, what is their context, what problem are we really solving? You balance a startup pace with taking a step back to research and test before going to production. Strong Figma skills. Native Dutch speaker. You’ll talk with healthcare professionals a lot, in their own language. A portfolio that shows your thinking: the user, the problem, how you approached it and how you measured whether it worked. Strong candidates may also Have worked on AI products. Have experience in healthcare, or another regulated environment such as legaltech, regtech or govtech. Have worked on a CE-certified or medical device product, and know what that means for usability testing. Have experience running usability studies or user interviews. Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines. Role Overview As a Hardware Test Engineer at Optics11, you play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our fiber-optic sensing systems. You develop and execute hardware tests at board and sub-system level, identifying potential issues early and helping our engineers deliver robust, production-ready solutions. Combining hands-on hardware engineering with test automation, you build test setups, analyze results, support prototype development, and help transfer testing processes from R&D to production. You will be part of our Sensing Platform Team, working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, production, and external partners. Develop and improve production and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) setups, procedures, and test jigs. Support troubleshooting, repairs, and root-cause investigations during development and production. Maintain an organized, safe, and well-equipped R&D laboratory, including equipment calibration and materials management. Independently plan and execute assigned activities, communicating progress, risks, and dependencies. A competitive salary and benefits package. 30 days of holiday per year. Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events. Qualifications BSc (HBO) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Applied Physics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience. 2+ years of relevant experience in hardware testing, test engineering, prototyping, or lab work on electronic or electro-optical products. Hands-on experience with laboratory instruments such as multimeter

jobs.title: Senior business analyst - deadline 03/11/2026
jobs.description: Job description : We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical teams to analyze business needs, define requirements, and ensure successful delivery of features within an Agile/SAFe environment. The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis. Key responsibilities : Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and SMEs to gather, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements. Feature & Backlog Management: Analyze upcoming roadmap features, identify business value, dependencies, risks, and gaps, and continuously refine the product backlog. User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements. Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required. Microsoft Power Platform: Understand Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse, access structures, data models, solution architecture, and inbound/outbound data flows. Agile & SAFe Delivery: Participate in PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily meetings, system demos, and other Agile/SAFe ceremonies. PI Preparation: Support pre-PI planning activities, identify knowledge gaps and dependencies, prepare refinement materials, and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure feature readiness. Definition of Ready & Definition of Done: Ensure that User Stories meet the agreed Definition of Ready (DoR) before entering a sprint and contain the necessary information to support the Definition of Done (DoD). Technical & Cross-Team Coordination: Collaborate with development leads, testers, Product Owners, and other teams to clarify technical feasibility, resolve dependencies, and maintain alignment on scope and responsibilities. User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Prepare UAT scenarios, use cases, and sample test data; coordinate end-user testing; collect and analyze feedback; and document decisions and follow-up backlog items. Delivery & Release Support: Verify that delivered functionality meets business requirements, prepare sprint release notes, and ensure that documentation, user guidance, and training materials are updated. Documentation & Traceability: Maintain centralized and accessible project documentation in tools such as SharePoint or Wiki, ensuring traceability from Epics and Features through User Stories, acceptance tests, and releases. AI-Assisted Analysis: Use AI capabilities such as Copilot, AI agents, and other relevant tools to support requirements gathering, process analysis, validation of assumptions, and initial solution ideation. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify business processes, improve requirements quality, and maintain a backlog buffer of approximately 1.5–2 sprints of ready User Stories. Job requirments: Proven experience as a Business Analyst in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments. jobs.title: KVGM Medewerker
jobs.description: Ben jij op zoek naar een centrale rol binnen KOERS waarbij kwaliteit, veiligheid, gezondheid en milieu bovenaan staan? Dat komt dan mooi uit! Wij zijn op zoek naar een KVGM Medewerker die onze organisatie komt versterken. Solliciteer snel op deze vacature, want jij maakt voor ons het verschil! Welke uitdagingen krijg jij als KVGM Medewerker? Als KVGM Medewerker ondersteun je onze organisatie bij het ontwikkelen, uitvoeren en verbeteren van het beleid op gebied van kwaliteit, veiligheid, gezondheid en milieu. Jij zorgt ervoor dat al onze collega’s hun werk veilig kunnen uitvoeren en draagt bij aan een gezonde werkomgeving. Je werkt nauw samen met de KVGM-coördinator en het management om de kwaliteit, arbeidsomstandigheden en het milieu te optimaliseren. Welke uitdagingen horen onder andere bij deze functie? Uitvoeren en ondersteunen van werkplekinspecties en veiligheidsrondes . Je bent regelmatig te vinden op onze verschillende bouwlocaties; Het signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen en verbetermogelijkheden en bespreekt dit met de KVGM-coördinator; Deelnemen aan en ondersteunen bij verschillende interne en externe audits ; Registeren en onderzoeken van incidenten, ongevallen en bijna-ongevallen; Onderhouden en verbeteren van het KVGM-managementsysteem; Het opstellen van een veiligheidsplan ; Het creëren van een gezonde werkomgeving zowel op kantoor als op onze diverse bouwplaatsen; Zorgdragen voor draagvlak binnen KOERS van veiligheidsbewustzijn; Het uitvoeren en up to date houden van de RI&E; Het verzorgen van veiligheidsinstructies, toolboxen en voorlichting ; Het regelen van keuringen van gereedschap en materieel. Je standplaats is Barendrecht (Rotterdam) , maar bent ook regelmatig op onze diverse projectlocaties (omgeving Randstand) te vinden. Je werkt nauw samen met de KVGM-coördinator en draagt bij aan periodieke rapportage aan onze Directeur Bouw. Wat verwachten wij van jou als KVGM Medewerker? Betrokkenheid, zelfstandigheid, een scherp oog voor veiligheid & kwaliteit en daarnaast plezier in je vak! Maak je werk uitdagender door op zoek te gaan naar nieuwe ideeën en werk daarin samen met je collega’s binnen KOERS. Is dit wat je zoekt? Dan hopen wij dat je over de volgende eigenschappen beschikt: Je hebt minimaal 3-5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie; Je hebt HBO werk- en denkniveau , een opleiding in het vakgebied MVK genoten en ervaring binnen de bouwsector ; Kennis van de relevante wet- en regelgeving; Kennis en ervaring omtrent ISO 9001, ISO 14001, VCA en SCL is een pré; Je hebt oog voor risico’s en uitdagingen; Je bent energiek , sociaal, ondernemend en daadkrachtig; Je bent flexibel en bezit het vermogen om snel te kunnen schakelen ; Je staat sterk in je (werk)schoenen en hebt oog voor detail. Wat bieden we jou? Een verantwoordelijke functie waar je als KAM Medewerker bijdraagt aan het creëren van een gezonde werkomgeving. Daarnaast bieden we jou: Een dienstverband van 32-40 uur per week; Een goed salaris dat boven de normen van de cao Bouw en Infra ligt. We gaan hier graag over in gesprek met jouw achtergrond en ervaring als uitgangspunt; Een auto van de zaak met tankpas volgens onze leaseregeling; Een informele werksfeer en gezellige collega’s ; Goed geregelde vrije dagen , 30 vakantiedagen, 10 dagen in het tijdspaarfonds en nog 3 dagen kort verzuim. In totaal dus 43 vakantiedagen. Deze zaken zijn uiteraard conform de cao Bouw en Infra; Een goed ingerichte werkplek; Pensioenopbouw conform de richtlijnen van de CAO Bouw en Infra, dit bouwen wij samen op; Een periodieke bijdrage aan je duurzame inzetbaarheid , zodat je gezond kunt blijven werken; De mogelijkheid voor het volgen van opleidingen en/of cursussen, want jouw groei/ontwikkeling vinden wij belangrijk. Wij kijken graag samen met jou naar de mogelijkheden binnen ons opleidingsbudget. Wil jij meebouwen aan de toekomst van KOERS? Wacht dan niet langer en reageer gelijk op deze vacature! Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Risk
jobs.description: Who We Are Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you. Role Summary The Risk team at Imprint is responsible for making smarter, faster credit decisions that balance growth with responsible risk management. The team builds the models, policies, and analytical systems that power underwriting, fraud detection, and portfolio optimization across all of Imprint’s credit programs. As a Data Scientist, Risk, you will own the modeling powering Imprint’s top-of-funnel credit decisioning—from application intake through approval—across every acquisition channel: direct affiliates (Credit Karma, NerdWallet), invitation-to-apply emails, direct mail, paid social, instant prescreens, and on-site applications. Your primary focus will be improving approval rates while maintaining credit quality: building better underwriting models, designing policy experiments, and uncovering segments where we can safely expand access to credit. This role sits at the intersection of credit and acquisition strategy. You will partner directly with Credit Strategy, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to build targeting models for new channels, evaluate channel-level credit performance, and connect acquisition volume to downstream economics—approval rates, vintage loss forecasts, LTV, CAC, and contribution profit. Increasingly, that means building not just analyses but AI-powered systems that can autonomously monitor approval rate, channel performance, diagnose shifts, and recommend policy adjustments. jobs.description: Tiger Analytics is a fast-growing advanced analytics consulting firm. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning and AI. We are the trusted analytics partner for several Fortune 100 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner. We are looking for top-notch talent as we continue to build the best analytics global consulting team in the world. The Power BI Architect will lead the design, strategy, and governance of the enterprise BI platform using Microsoft Power BI and the Azure ecosystem. This role involves assessing infrastructure requirements, defining best practices, guiding BI Engineers, enabling security, handling large data, and ensuring scalable, high-performing BI solutions that align with business needs. Key Requirements: Design scalable BI solutions with a focus on infrastructure, capacity, and licensing needs. Conduct capability assessments to align Power BI adoption with enterprise goals. jobs.description: About WOO X WOO X is a global centralised crypto trading platform offering spot and perpetual futures trading. With roots in quantitative trading, we focus on the details that matter to traders: liquidity, execution quality, and reliable tools. Transparency is part of the product. Our live Proof of Reserves & Liabilities dashboard gives users visibility into reported platform assets and user liabilities. Our team is fully remote. We’re looking for people who know their craft, are curious about the business, and want a hand in improving how the exchange works. You’ll build the pipelines and data models that make exchange data reliable and useful for analytics, reporting, and day-to-day business decisions. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a focus on platform engineering. You’ll work with engineering and business colleagues to understand how data is produced and used, address quality issues, and make the platform easier to maintain as requirements evolve. What you’ll do Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines using Python, SQL, Kafka, and Spark. Develop and operate Airflow workflows, including scheduling, dependency management, retries, and recovery. Design and maintain data models and warehouse datasets for analytics and reporting. Improve data quality and freshness through validation, monitoring, and investigation of upstream and downstream issues. Optimise pipeline and query performance, and manage processing and storage costs. Work with data users to define datasets and metrics, and document data flows, transformations, and dependencies. What you’ll bring Data engineering experience within crypto or Web3, including responsibility for production pipelines or a data platform. Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building maintainable data processing workflows. Hands-on experience with Airflow, Kafka, and Spark. Experience with data warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data modelling. The ability to investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot pipeline failures, and resolve underlying causes. The ability to work independently and communicate technical details and business requirements clearly in Mandarin. Nice to have Experience at a centralised crypto exchange, particularly with trading, order, or account data. BI experience, including supporting dashboards, defining metrics, or preparing datasets for business users. Strong English communication skills. Working with us This role is fully remote within APAC, with Mandarin as the team’s main working language. You’ll work on a data platform connected to the daily operations of a crypto exchange and help colleagues get dependable answers from its data. If you enjoy building data systems and understanding how people use them, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist, Lead Generation
jobs.description: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz , All About Cookies , and OnlyInYourState . We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies. Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment. We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries. WHY JOIN US? You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato . YOUR ROLE You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS. Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time. We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own. By the end of your first year: Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier Carrier conversion data running in production models Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives Output the business trusts and uses without rework MUST HAVE 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify. You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view Expert Python and SQL NICE TO HAVES Real ad budget spent in live auctions Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker CI/CD deployment Want to accelerate your career? Apply now! Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran

jobs.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role This is a senior individual contributor role in our Data Services & Governance team where you'll act as the thought and technical leader owning the semantic layer and analytics standards for Pleo. This means that you won't own a domain but you'll own what good looks like across all of them by developing, improving , maintaining and evangelising our modelling standards and AI-augmented development practices that every Analytics Engineer work with, regardless of which team they sit in. The semantic layer you will be designing and maintaining will be the single source of truth that AI agents, BI tools, and analysts query. This is foundational work with company-wide reach which will be ideal for you if you enjoy building things from the ground up. Our semantic layer is still in very early stage. Tooling selection is live, and this role has a strong voice in it. Our BI stack is also in transition so, you would not be inheriting a mature setup and maintaining it. You'd be deciding what it should be, then building it. For additional context, our tech stack currently include: GCP, BigQuery, dbt Core, Airflow, SQL, Python, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot. Who you'll work with You'll report to the Data Engineering Manager who oversees the Data Infra & MLOps team as well as the Data Services & Governance team. Your primary relationship will be with Analytics Engineers embedded across the Intelligence function who should come to you for architecture guidance, semantic layer decisions, and standards questions. You will also partner with a Staff Data Engineer on data engineering standards and pipeline practices, and with others on self-serve analytics and BI tooling governance. You'll engage with the Data Serving team on entity definitions and with the GenAI Platform team on what AI-ready data looks like at the platform boundary. What you'll be doing Own the semantic layer: define what a metric definition is, how it's structured, where it lives, and how it's enforced. The goal is one canonical definition of Monthly recurring revenue (MRR), churn, transaction, customer - used by analysts, BI tools, and AI tools without divergence. You make that real, not aspirational. Set data modelling standards for the function: what clean, layered, well-tested dbt architecture looks like across all domains, at all levels of complexity. Build and run the Analytics Engineering community of practice including code reviews, shared patterns, documentation, onboarding etc. The goal is to create a social infrastructure that makes standards stick. Own the AI-native development practice. Use AI coding tools as a native part of how you write, review, and migrate data models (not as a demonstration, but as your actual workflow). Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Machine Learning
jobs.description: At Signifyd , we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy. Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here ! Signifyd AI Lab (SAIL) builds the ML products behind Signifyd's fraud and risk decisions. We improve the predictive performance of the models that decide e-commerce transactions at scale, we scale the ML capabilities of our Risk organization, and we push into the new markets and problem spaces that expand the market Signifyd can sell to. Every space in this department is a mix of experimentation, code, and statistics. We don't create walls between the people who have the ideas and the people who build them. The team splits its time between near-term continuous model improvements and longer-horizon innovation bets to improve the company’s capabilities in 2027 and beyond. These bets surface from the ground up in an environment where we believe those closest to the problems are best placed to understand how to solve them. We’re hiring a manager to lead one of the teams in this department. Who You Are You are a hands-on Player-Coach manager who thrives in ambiguity—where the roadmap is a set of hypotheses, and the answer to "will this work?" is "we'll know in three weeks." You bring: Technical Credibility (The "Player"): You stay close enough to the work to have a grounded opinion. Leadership & Rigor (The "Coach"): You hold a high bar for evidence without becoming a bottleneck to experimentation. You mentor engineers to own their code quality, and you translate complex ML performance metrics into clear business outcomes for Risk leadership. Executive Judgment: You know how to balance research bets against quarterly delivery, disagree and commit when decisions are made, and build an environment where well-documented negative experimental results are celebrated as real progress. Develop career plans with team members, provide guidance on skill development, and follow up on their evolution. Engage in regular 1:1s, give constant feedback, and create a safe environment for open discussion — including the discussions that follow an experiment that didn't work. Set clear goals, mentor the team, and foster a collaborative environment across a geographically distributed organization. Encourage a culture of learning and improvement, provide technical guidance, and support team members in both technical and soft skills. Conduct technical and hiring-manager interviews, train the team on interviewing techniques, and help us keep raising the bar as we grow. Identify and address gaps in team capabilities and processes to enhance team efficiency and success. Run a portfolio of experiments, not a delivery queue Partner with your tech leads, who own and drive the technical roadmap for their areas. Your job is not to be the sole source of ideas — it is to pressure-test them, sharpen them, make sure the strongest ones get resourced, and make sure the people generating them have the room and the support to do it. When you do bring an idea, you bring it as a peer

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
jobs.description: Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies. This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems. A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality. Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on. You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies. You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines. Key Responsibilities Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness. Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions. Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards. Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues. Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required. Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews. Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. Qualification path Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring. Basic Requirements Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English. Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years. Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills. Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools. Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer. Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently. High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets Preferred Qualifications Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification. Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems. Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering. Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements. Equal Opportunity All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.
